name: Workbench P-005 native Windows Organizer exact placement
summary: The maintained Windows fixture passed 30 model/native WPF Organizer checks on the signed-in desktop. Plan, fleet and canonical goal actions each returned measured placement receipts for two exact HWNDs, unsupported/offline/missing receipts for three others and left an unselected same-process window unchanged. Late cancellation and identity replacement refused geometry mutation. Separate current-source settings migration passed35. This is current-build fixture-PUI evidence; installed-artifact three-OS acceptance and shipment remain pending.
